title: Quick Arabian Tempeh Kebabs
description: A flavor-filled and nutritious meal inspired by Arabian cuisine, made with marinated tempeh skewers grilled to perfection.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together quick mixed spice, lemon juice, and olive oil.
Add the tempeh cubes to the marinade and mix until coated.
Thread the marinated tempeh, onion, bell pepper, and tomato onto skewers.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the tempeh is golden brown and the vegetables are tender.
Warm the pita bread by wrapping it in foil and heating it on the grill for a few minutes.
Serve the kebabs in the pita bread with your favorite toppings.
